classification.difficultyReason: Directly read where each supplied parabola is above, below or on the x-axis; distinguish strict from inclusive endpoints and recognise the single-point and all-real solutions for tangent graphs. No graph construction or algebraic root finding is required.

content.prompt: Use the graphs given to find the set of $x$-values described by each inequality.

spec.description: Upward parabola with marked intercepts; source origin numeral omitted under house graph rules.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph visible in question editions.

answer.worked:
The graph is below the $x$-axis between its intercepts at $x=-3$ and $x=5$. The inequality is strict, so neither endpoint is included.

Thus, $-3<x<5$.

spec.description: Upward parabola with both roots and y-intercept marked.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph visible in question editions.

answer.worked:
The graph is above the $x$-axis to the left of $x=-4$ and to the right of $x=1$. The strict inequality excludes both intercepts.

Thus, $x<-4$ or $x>1$.

spec.description: Downward parabola tangent to the x-axis at -2.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph visible in question editions.

answer.worked:
The graph never lies above the $x$-axis. It is on the axis only at its vertex, where $x=-2$.

Thus, $x=-2$.

spec.description: Downward parabola with roots -1 and 2 and y-intercept 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph visible in question editions.

answer.worked:
The graph is below the $x$-axis when $x<-1$ or $x>2$, and on the axis at $x=-1$ and $x=2$. Include these intercepts because the inequality is non-strict.

Thus, $x\leq-1$ or $x\geq2$.

spec.description: Corrected upward parabola: vertex placed at -3 to agree with the printed expression and curve label. Original source places it at positive 3.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph visible in question editions.

answer.worked:
The graph lies above the $x$-axis except at $x=-3$, where it touches the axis. Hence its $y$-values are non-negative for every real $x$.

Thus, all real values of $x$ satisfy the inequality.

spec.description: Downward parabola with vertex (0,9) and roots -3/2 and 3/2.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph visible in question editions.

answer.worked:
The graph lies below the $x$-axis to the left of $x=-\frac32$ and to the right of $x=\frac32$. The strict inequality excludes both intercepts.

Thus, $x<-\frac32$ or $x>\frac32$.
